instructions.question: Does the tweet lean positive or negative in the author's attitude, mood or evaluation, or does it have no lean at all?
instructions.rule: Even a mild lean decides the label. Looking forward to something, wanting something, inviting people to an event, mild interest or RIP wishes are positive. Small annoyances, can't-go remarks, delays, :( or #fml are negative. Neutral is only for texts with no lean: facts, questions, impersonal news, score reports, and sports or political commentary and debate about others without personal feeling.

neutral.what: Facts, questions, impersonal news, scores, sports predictions and critiques, debating replies, offhand remarks with no feeling.
examples: @user dustin johnson is a thursday fri player when the weekend comes and he has to handle the pressure he folds up like a lawnchair
Trayce Thompson's 2-run double gives the White Sox a 5-4 lead in the 7th.
@user You do realize that the 1st Amendment doesn't just apply to Christians, right?
neutral.cues: score, lead, round, may, reportedly, who do you think, right?, I think
neutral.not_for: Personal annoyance or sadness is negative; personal excitement or invitations are positive.

positive.what: Enthusiasm, liking, anticipation, wanting, invitations to fun events, promos, mild interest, gratitude or condolences.
examples: It’s Tuesday night in Athens! AKA karaoke night at the Volstead so come see me!!
I just saw a glance at the new Galaxy Note 5. Looks interesting. That may be my next phone.
I want IHOP tomorrow morning
I just heard about Frank Gifford. Anyone who ever watched Monday Night Football enjoyed it more with him. Rest in peace.
positive.cues: come see, join us, can't wait, love, looking forward, I want, best, rest in peace, !!, <3
positive.not_for: Score reports and impersonal news of a team's win are neutral.

negative.what: Complaints, annoyance, disappointment, sadness, boredom, mockery, insults or sarcasm, even mild.
examples: A Thursday night with no Waterloo road on! #boring
Just remembered I'm taking the PSSAs tomorrow. #Fml
@user TMILLS is going to Tucson! But the 29th and it’s on a Thursday :(
Dream High 2 sucks compared to the 1st one.
negative.cues: sucks, #fml, :(, can't, boring, disappointed, delayed, hate, wtf, c'mon
negative.not_for: Swearing for excitement is positive; impersonal critique of athletes or politicians is neutral.
